import json, subprocess, sys, time
req = {'cases': [{'primitive': 'allreduce', 'mode': 3, 'root': 0, 'segments': 4, 'words': 1,
                  'capacity': 1, 'start': 0,
                  'events': [{'op': 'data', 'rank': 0, 'p': 0}, {'op': 'data', 'rank': 1, 'p': 0},
                             {'op': 'data', 'rank': 2, 'p': 0}, {'op': 'data', 'rank': 3, 'p': 0}] +
                            [{'op': 'snap', 'tag': 'T' * 64} for _ in range(65530)],
                  'trace': 0}]}
raw = json.dumps(req).encode()
t0 = time.time()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-B', '/workspace/project/solver.py'], input=raw, capture_output=True)
dt = time.time() - t0
print('rc', p.returncode, 'stdout bytes', len(p.stdout), 'secs %.1f' % dt, p.stderr.decode()[:200])
out = json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
print('snaps', len(out['cases'][0]['snapshots']), 'keys', sorted(out['cases'][0]['snapshots'][0]))
PYEOF
